content:
John plans to sell his lego sets to fund video game purchases. He starts with 13 lego sets and sells some number of them at $15 each. He buys 8 video games at $20 each and has $5 left.

The total amount of money he obtained from selling lego sets is the cost of the video games plus the leftover money:
8 × $20 = $160 (cost of video games)
$160 + $5 = $165 (total money from sales)

Since each lego set sells for $15, the number of lego sets sold is:
$165 ÷ $15 = 11 sets

He originally had 13 lego sets, so the number he still has is:
13 − 11 = 2

Answer: 2
